description: The ManageEngine ADAudit Plus login page is open in Microsoft Edge. A workgroup server (localhost) has been configured. Log in with username 'admin' and password 'Admin@2024'. Then navigate to the Admin area (click the '...' menu in the top navigation bar, then select 'Admin'). In the left sidebar, click 'Logon Settings'. On the Logon Settings page, you will see the 'Single Sign On' and 'Two-Factor Authentication' tabs. On the 'Single Sign On' tab, check 'Enable Single Sign-on with Active Directory', then select the 'NTLMv2 Authentication' radio button (instead of 'SAML Authentication'). Save the logon settings.
